scripts._comment: Env lives in one root .env; dotenv-cli loads it for the child process and its workers, which Next would not otherwise see from apps/web.
scripts._comment_typecheck: next typegen first: layout.tsx uses LayoutProps<"/">, a global Next generates into .next/types. On a machine that has built before, the folder is already there and tsc passes; on a fresh clone or in CI it is not, and tsc fails with 'Cannot find name LayoutProps'. Generating it here keeps one command correct everywhere.
